title: RNAscope In Situ Hybridization, Imaging, and Quantification
author: Le Zhang
materials: Counterstain all tissue sections with DAPI.

steps.title: Prepare and Store Tissue
steps.instruction: Flash freeze human brain tissue from the prefrontal cortex of either PD or controls and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Embed and Section Tissue
steps.instruction: Embed frozen tissue in OCT and section at 10μm using a cryostat.

steps.title: Fix Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Fix fresh frozen sections in 10% neutral buffered formalin for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Dehydrate Sections
steps.instruction: Sequentially dehydrate sections in ethanol series for 5 minutes each at room temperature.

steps.title: Pretreat Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Pretreat tissue sections with hydrogen peroxide and protease to block endogenous peroxidase activity and optimally permeabilize the sections.

steps.title: Hybridize RNAscope Probes
steps.instruction: Hybridize target RNAscope probes (e.g., EPHA6, CBLN2, PLCG2, and HSP90AA1) to tissue sections.

steps.title: Amplify Signal and Dye
steps.instruction: Amplify signal and apply fluorescent dyes of Opal Dye 570 or 650.

steps.title: Perform Control Probing
steps.instruction: Use positive and negative control probes to ensure detection of target RNA signals and lack of non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Positive controls: human POLR2S, PPIB, UBC, and HPRT-1

steps.title: Capture Confocal Images
steps.instruction: Capture images using a Leica SP8 motorized staging confocal microscope with a 20x lens (Leica #506517), keeping imaging settings constant between healthy controls and PD.

substeps.instruction: Detect cells using the DAPI channel
Identify and measure probe channel signals
Calculate estimated spot count per cell for the entire cryosection

steps.title: Analyze and Compare Data
steps.instruction: Compare RNA expression in human brain sections from PD patients to healthy control human brains and determine statistical significance.

substeps.instruction: Analyze approximately 10,000 nuclei from each tissue section
Determine statistical significance using Student’s t-test
